question: Which of these books is written by Shashi Tharoor?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Why I am Hindu" **is a book written by **Shashi Tharoor,** an** Indian politician, author, and former diplomat.**
 
• **Published in 2018,** the book explores the author's personal journey and reflections on his Hindu identity.
 
• **In the book, Tharoor examines various aspects of Hinduism, including its **history, philosophy, traditions, and practices.
 
• He delves into the complexity and diversity within **Hinduism, **highlighting its pluralistic nature and the multitude of interpretations and beliefs that exist within the religion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** "A State of Freedom":** It is actually written by **Neel Mukherjee**.

 
 
• Published in **2017, "A State of Freedom" **is a novel that explores themes of i**dentity, migration, and social inequality through the interconnected stories of various characters in contemporary India.**
 
 
 
• **"Autumn": ** It is written by** Ali Smith. "Autumn" **is the first installment in a four-part series of novels referred to as the** "Seasonal Quartet."**
 
 
• ​Published in 2016, it explores themes of time,** memory, **and political change through the friendship between an elderly man and a young girl in post-Brexit Britain.
 
 
 
• **"Songs of a Coward":** It is written by** ****Perumal Murugan**.
 
 
• **"Songs of a Coward"** is a collection of poems that explores various themes such as **love, loss, history, and society, often drawing inspiration from Daruwalla's own experiences and observations.**
